readings: Group records by eventannotm, treating missing timing as its own group. Ignore missing instownpct values. Select timing groups whose average instownpct is strictly greater than the average instownpct across all records with nonmissing ownership. Return one row with the unweighted mean of the selected groups’ average instownpct values and the unweighted mean of their differences from that overall record-level average, without rounding.

Group records by eventannotm, treating missing timing as its own group. Ignore missing instownpct values and exclude groups with no nonmissing ownership values. Select timing groups whose average instownpct is strictly greater than the unweighted mean of the timing groups’ average instownpct values. Return one row with the unweighted mean of the selected groups’ average instownpct values and the unweighted mean of their differences from that all-groups mean, without rounding.
queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
timing_groups AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
)
SELECT
  AVG(group_avg) AS mean_group_avg_instownpct,
  AVG(group_avg - overall.avg_instownpct) AS mean_difference
FROM timing_groups
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE group_avg > overall.avg_instownpct

WITH timing_groups AS (
    SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_instownpct
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY eventannotm
),
all_groups AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_instownpct) AS all_groups_mean
    FROM timing_groups
)
SELECT
    AVG(t.avg_instownpct) AS selected_groups_mean,
    AVG(t.avg_instownpct - a.all_groups_mean) AS mean_difference
FROM timing_groups AS t
CROSS JOIN all_groups AS a
WHERE t.avg_instownpct > a.all_groups_mean
